_comment: The rest of the staff's standard lines. By NPC, then line key (slot + number): the key pins the line's INFO ID, which names its voice file. npcgen's slots: hello; Willem's helloLow, anyRank, rankC/B/A/S; Cassius's and Brynja's helloOn, helloOff; helloNew, goodbye, about, idle; Willem's taunt (vanilla's exact words, in a combat topic of his own). Caralion's (AGHallResidentNoble) (drafting/caralion_approved.json), added after the five so no earlier line moves. Marius's (AGHallResidentVeteran) (drafting/marius_approved.json), added after Caralion's; no about lines (adventurers get none).

aboutTopics._comment: The about lines' question, by NPC: the clerks alone keep 'What's Guild work like around here?'; Willem and Merila answer 'Tell me about the Adventurers Guild.', the cook, barkeeper and server 'Tell me about the Guild Hall.'. An NPC in neither (Caralion) has no answer: his about lines stay here only to hold their IDs and are not built.

Guild.prompt: Tell me about the Adventurers Guild.

Hall.prompt: Tell me about the Guild Hall.

AGHallGuildMaster.helloLow1: Few at your rank last the year. Let's make you one of them.
AGHallGuildMaster.helloLow2: Still breathing. Good. I mean to keep you that way.
AGHallGuildMaster.anyRank1: Always time for one of ours. Tell me what you need.
AGHallGuildMaster.anyRank2: Glad to have you home. Is there anything I can do?
AGHallGuildMaster.rankC1: I worry about you a little less these days. It does me good.
AGHallGuildMaster.rankB1: I'd trust you with the new ones, and that's no small thing.
AGHallGuildMaster.rankA1: Not many get as far as you have. I'm proud of you.
AGHallGuildMaster.rankS1: I never got as high as you. Glad I lived to see it.
AGHallGuildMaster.helloNew1: Looking to sign on? Hmm... yes, I think you'd make a fine adventurer. Apply at the counter when it's open.
AGHallGuildMaster.helloNew2: Welcome to the hall. It's a hard trade, and I won't lie about that. Talk to one of the girls at the counter if you're interested in joining.
AGHallGuildMaster.goodbye2: Stay alive, that's all I ask.
AGHallGuildMaster.about1: Same as it's always been. A farmer's scared, something's out in the dark, and someone has to go and look. This hold has plenty of that.
AGHallGuildMaster.about2: We start everyone small. Wolves, skeevers, a cave by a farm. The barrows will wait, as the fools who rushed them didn't come back.
AGHallGuildMaster.about3: Anyone can post a job at our boards, and any member can take one their rank allows. The ranks keep the green ones alive.
AGHallGuildMaster.idle1: Forty of us, that first spring.
AGHallGuildMaster.idle2: Room on that board for a few more parties.
AGHallGuildMaster.idle3: This shoulder knows when snow's coming.
AGHallGuildMaster.idle4: Never did make S-rank. Wasn't within my grasp.
AGHallGuildMaster.idle5: Twenty-five years this hall stood empty. Damn wars...
AGHallGuildMaster.idle6: I'd rather lose a contract than an adventurer.
AGHallGuildMaster.goodbye1: You know where to find me.

AGHallAssistant.hello1: Adventurer. If you've a correction for my maps, I'm listening.
AGHallAssistant.hello2: Good, one of the careful ones. What can I find for you?
AGHallAssistant.hello3: If it's the library you want, I know the right shelf.
AGHallAssistant.helloNew1: If you mean to join, see the clerks. Once you've done that, see me.
AGHallAssistant.helloNew2: You're not on the roster. The clerks can remedy that, during open hours at the counter.
AGHallAssistant.about2: Its real strength is its records. Every cave reported, every beast described. Most members never read them.
AGHallAssistant.about3: Scouts find the trouble, members end it, and the counters pay. I sit in the middle and make sure the three agree.
AGHallAssistant.idle4: Another location for the scouts to look into.
AGHallAssistant.about1: An Imperial charter, nearly two centuries old. Skyrim only got its hall some thirty years ago, and the war emptied it soon after.
AGHallAssistant.idle5: A hero, by his own account.
AGHallAssistant.idle6: No date on it. Of course.

AGHallBarkeeper.helloOn1: Sit, sit. What can I pour you?
AGHallBarkeeper.helloOn2: Pull up a stool. What are we having?
AGHallBarkeeper.helloOn3: A drink, a meal, or the news? I've got all three.
AGHallBarkeeper.helloOff1: A barkeep's never off. What is it?
AGHallBarkeeper.helloOff2: Between pours. What's the word on the road?
AGHallBarkeeper.helloNew1: No card? Your coin's as good as anyone's.
AGHallBarkeeper.helloNew2: Take a seat, and tell me what brought you here.
AGHallBarkeeper.about1: The Guild's one hall in all Skyrim, friend. Members sleep up top, sweat in the cellar, and drink with me in between.
AGHallBarkeeper.about2: Every guild hall I've known lives or dies by its bar. I make sure this one lives.
AGHallBarkeeper.about3: The only bar in Skyrim where everyone's armed and nobody starts anything. Mostly.
AGHallBarkeeper.idle2: Somewhere warm. Who am I fooling?
AGHallBarkeeper.idle5: All those years south, and here I am.
AGHallBarkeeper.idle6: No Thalmor at my bar, at least.

AGHallServer.helloOn1: Sit down before you fall down. What'll it be?
AGHallServer.helloOn2: Well? Are you eating, drinking, or just looking? I don't mind either way.
AGHallServer.helloOn3: Name it. And don't say surprise me.
AGHallServer.helloOff1: Go on, I'm nosy. Who's done what?
AGHallServer.helloNew2: New, are you? Everyone here thinks they're the hero. You'll fit right in.
AGHallServer.goodbye2: Good luck out there; hope you land a big one. Big enough to give a certain someone a nice tip next time.
AGHallServer.goodbye4: Find me something worth talking about.
AGHallServer.about3: Loud and happy, most days. When a bunk upstairs goes empty, it's quiet for a day or two.
AGHallServer.idle2: My own place. My name over the door.
AGHallServer.idle3: That's not how I heard it.
AGHallServer.helloNew1: You don't need a guild card to talk to me.
AGHallServer.goodbye3: Don't get yourself killed out there. You'd break my heart.
AGHallServer.about1: Depends who's asking. Sit a while and I'll tell you who's lying about what they killed.
AGHallServer.about2: Warm fires, full purses, and a room full of handsome fools who've just cheated death. What's not to love?
AGHallServer.idle1: That one's trouble. My favourite kind.

AGHallCook.hello1: Mind the stove, it bites. What can I do for you?
AGHallCook.hello2: Did you eat today? Don't lie to me.
AGHallCook.hello3: In or out, child, you're under my feet.
AGHallCook.helloNew1: A stranger, is it? State your business, then.
AGHallCook.helloNew2: Visitors keep to the tables, dear. The kitchen's mine.
AGHallCook.goodbye1: Go on, then. Mind the steps.
AGHallCook.goodbye3: Go carefully. I'm too old to worry this much.
AGHallCook.about1: A roof, a fire and a hot meal for whoever walks in. That's all a hall needs to be.
AGHallCook.about2: Busier than the old days, though not half as loud.
AGHallCook.about3: I fed the first forty in this hall, and I'll feed this lot the same. They're no less trouble.
AGHallCook.idle3: They used to sing in here.
AGHallCook.idle6: Where's that bread knife got to?

AGHallResidentNoble.helloLow1: Scraping by down there? How quaint.
AGHallResidentNoble.rankC1: Still here? Don't let it go to your head, even skeevers have their place I suppose.
AGHallResidentNoble.rankB1: My family would call you respectable. I'm not my family.
AGHallResidentNoble.rankA1: Your reputation is growing. In Cloudrest they'd welcome you with a feast. How disgusting.
AGHallResidentNoble.rankS1: You're an S rank now? Even I can't pretend that's luck. Good day to you.
AGHallResidentNoble.anyRank1: Make it quick. I've a letter to write.
AGHallResidentNoble.anyRank2: You have my attention. Try to deserve it.
AGHallResidentNoble.helloNew1: Not a member? Then you've no business speaking to me.
AGHallResidentNoble.helloNew2: Are you lost, or simply poor?
AGHallResidentNoble.goodbye3: Until I find a use for you.
AGHallResidentNoble.about1: Dirty, mostly. I leave the digging to people built for it. The counter has the details.
AGHallResidentNoble.about2: Ask a Nord. They enjoy that sort of thing.
AGHallResidentNoble.idle1: Nine generations, and I end up in a Nord barn.
AGHallResidentNoble.idle2: My cousin at the Embassy will hear of this.
AGHallResidentNoble.idle5: The best room, and it still smells of Nord poverty.

AGHallResidentVeteran.helloLow1: Stand up straight. Now, what do you want?
AGHallResidentVeteran.rankC1: Starting to stand like a fighter. Much better.
AGHallResidentVeteran.rankB1: Steady hands, steady feet. You've gotten the hang of it.
AGHallResidentVeteran.rankA1: Not much left I can teach you. Ask anyway.
AGHallResidentVeteran.rankS1: Never thought I'd see one of ours climb that high.
AGHallResidentVeteran.helloNew1: Civilian, eh? Mind what you touch.
AGHallResidentVeteran.helloNew2: Sign up first. Then we'll talk.
AGHallResidentVeteran.goodbye2: Check your equipment before you go.
AGHallResidentVeteran.goodbye3: Come home on your own feet.
AGHallResidentVeteran.idle1: I'm going to feel that one in the morning.
AGHallResidentVeteran.idle3: In my day we drilled before breakfast.
AGHallResidentVeteran.idle6: Thirty years, and they still drop their guard.
